# MotoNav: Google Navigation SDK feed messages, as the Android code converts them.
# Do not edit the frames by hand: the Kotlin test NavInfoGoldenTest (android/navsdk) fails if its
# output differs. To rewrite them after a deliberate change:
#   MOTONAV_PRINT_NAVINFO=/tmp/out.txt ./gradlew :navsdk:testDebugUnitTest      (then copy the frame column)
#
# Format, one case per line:   name ; frame (hex) ; what the display must show
# The frames are numbered 1, 2, 3 ... and sent in this order to ONE connection. The third column is
# the text the firmware prints for what it would draw (its `expect:` line). It was WRITTEN AND
# REVIEWED BY HAND, case by case, against the meaning of the Google message the case stands for.
# A Python test (firmware/host/tests_py/test_navinfo_cases.py) sends the frames through the
# firmware's real receiver and compares. Nothing here involves a phone or a radio.
#
# What each case stands for (NavInfo / StepInfo fields):
#   straight_1200 .. fork_right_900   ordinary maneuvers, from the feed's ENROUTE state
#   sharp_right_120                   120 m shows as 100 m: the display rounds distances (D-22)
#   uturn_counterclockwise_80         Google's counterclockwise U-turn is the left-hand icon
#   uturn_clockwise_80                Google's clockwise U-turn is the right-hand icon
#   distance_unknown                  the feed gave no distance: the display shows "--", not 0
#   road_name_non_latin               an Indian-script road name: the 5x7 font cannot draw it, so
#                                     the road line is empty (DECISIONS.md D-20). A known limitation.
#   rerouting / stopped / arrived     REROUTING, STOPPED (navigation ended) and STOPPED after the
#                                     SDK's arrival event
straight_1200 ; 01010119010000B0040000401F0000840300000952696E6720526F61647BF6 ; screen=Navigating icon=Straight distance="1.2 km" road="Ring Road"
turn_left_450 ; 01010217010100C2010000401F000084030000074D4720526F61648EC6 ; screen=Navigating icon=TurnLeft distance="450 m" road="MG Road"

uturn_clockwise_80 ; 0101081C01080050000000401F0000840300000C4272696761646520526F6164810E ; screen=Navigating icon=UTurnRight distance="80 m" road="Brigade Road"

rerouting ; 01010F10020000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00E98A ; screen=Rerouting
